newsitem.title: USA: Hughes, NextWave sign PCS supply pact.
newsitem.headline: Hughes, NextWave sign PCS supply pact.

text.p: Hughes Network Systems Inc and NextWave Telecom Inc said on Monday they had signed an agreement under which Hughes will make and supply up to $1 billion in equipment to NextWave over the next six years.

To support these activities, Hughes has committed to a $50 million equity investment in NextWave. Under terms of the agreement, Hughes also has committed to financing the purchase of $245 million of equipment by NextWave and has the option to finance and supply up to an additional $755 million of equipment.

The equipment -- based on CDMA technology -- will be used in NextWave's digital wireless personal communications network, referred to as PCS. The agreement also calls for the joint development of advanced products and services that will be used in NextWave's nationwide network.

NextWave and Hughes will also work together to develop products that provide enhanced wireless residential and in-building business services and to develop specialized data communications products for use with communications services.

The agreement commits both companies to work together in the provision of wireless airtime. Under this arrangement, NextWave has agreed to provide Hughes with favorable wholesale airtime rates, and Hughes has agreed to offer NextWave wireless services in conjunction with certain wireless services that Hughes may deploy in the future.

"Wireless and satellite communications systems using Hughes' equipment currently operate in numerous countries throughout the world," said Allen Salmasi, NextWave's chairman and chief executive. "We are very pleased that Hughes has joined the ranks of CDMA equipment manufacturers and has made its technical excellence available to NextWave."

Through its participation in the C-Block auction, which was reserved for small businesses and entrepreneurs, NextWave was the winning bidder for 63 PCS licenses representing 110 million potential customers. NextWave is the parent company of NextWave Personal Communications Inc, NextWave Wireless Inc and TELE*code Inc.
Hughes Network Systems is a subsidiary of Hughes Electronics Corp.
